content: I am aware that we need to decide on a host for the shared birthday dinner before the weekend

I need to check my work schedule before deciding to host.
I notice Kwame hasn't volunteered yet either.
I'm relieved Kwame didn't volunteer either, so I'm not the only one avoiding it.
I'm hoping Ines or someone else will step up, so I don't have to host.

I notice Bea offered to host on Saturday or Sunday, which is good, maybe she'll do it.
I note that Bea is willing to host, which solves the hosting issue if others agree.
I see Ines replied to Bea asking about day preference, but I'm not going to jump in yet.
